summary.text: Farid Ishac, a Libertarian Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 11th District to Jeremy Moss.
An automotive engineer, he described himself as a Wayne State University alumnus.

paragraphs.text: Ishac was born in Livonia, Michigan, graduated from Detroit Catholic Central High School and earned degrees from Wayne State University, according to Ballotpedia.
His listed career experience includes working as an engineer. In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey he described himself as an automotive engineer with 37 years of experience and a Wayne State MBA.
The Libertarian Party nominated him at its convention on June 28, 2026.
He said he ran to show voters other choices.
He received 0.8% of the vote to Jeremy Moss's 60.9%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
